title: FA/13/2013 of MAYANK KUKRETI Vs SMT. MRINAL KUKRETI

paras.text:
FA NO.13 OF 2013
AND
AO NO.208 OF 2012
Hon'ble V. K. Bist, A.C.J.
Hon'ble U. C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Pankaj Purohit, Advocate present
for appellant-Smt. Mrinal Dimri Kukreti in
AO no.208/2012.
Mr. Bhupesh Kandpal, Advocate
present for the respondent-Capt. Mayank
Kukreti.
First Appeal no.13/2013 was filed by
Mayank Kukreti (husband) against the
judgment and decree dated 20.01.2013 passed
by the Principal Judge, Family Court,
Dehradun in O.S. no.274/2009, whereby the
suit filed by him under Section 13 of the
Hindu Marriage Act was dismissed. Appeal
from Order (AO) no.208/2012 has been filed
by Smt. Mrinal Dimri Kukreti (wife) against
the judgment and order dated 04.02.2012
passed by the Principal Judge, Family Court,
Dehradun in O.S. no.374/2009, whereby
application 19A moved by the wife for
maintenance and actual litigations expenses
was rejected.
During the pendency, the matter was
referred to the Mediation Centre of this
Court, wherein joint and individual sessions
were held between the parties. Vide report /
agreement dated 26.09.2014, the Incharge,
Mediation Centre has reported that the matter
has amicably been settled between the
parties. The aforesaid settlement / agreement
dated 26.09.2014 is on record.

Learned counsel for the parties
submitted before this Court that both the
parties have settled their disputes amicably
and entered into settlement. Pursuant to the
settlement deed, a demand draft of Rs.8
Lakhs (Rupees Eight Lakhs only) issued in
the name of Mrinal Dimri Kukreti has already
been deposited in the Registry. Registry is
directed to handover the same to Mr. Pankaj
Purohit, Advocate within 24 hours.
In view of amicable settlement
between the parties, First Appeal no.13/2013
is allowed. As a consequence thereof, the
judgment dated 21.01.2013 passed by the
Principal Judge, Family Court, Dehradun is
set aside and the suit filed under Section 13
of the Hindu Marriage Act is decreed in
terms of settlement deed dated 26.09.2014.
Appeal from Order no.208/2012 also
stands disposed of accordingly.
Stay application no.4837/2012 &
CLMA no.789/2013 thus stand disposed of.
 (U. C. Dhyani, J.) (V. K. Bist, A.C.J.)
Dated 11.11.2014
Rawat
